headlines.title_en: CSRC issues 'Opinions on Capital Market Support for Building a New Model of Real Estate Development'
headlines.summary_en: The Opinions consist of four parts with twelve articles, mainly including the following: First, overall requirements. headlines.title: 两部门：商业用房购房贷款期限一般不超过10年，最长不超过15年
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》的通知。通知提出，申请贷款购买的商业用房应为已竣工备案的房屋。银行业金融机构发放商业用房购房贷款应符合最低首付比例要求。商业用房购房贷款期限一般不超过10年，最长不超过15年。自然人申请商业用房购房贷款的，应参照个人住房贷款支出与收入比例、个人债务支出与收入比例的上限要求执行。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Commercial property purchase loan terms generally should not exceed 10 years, with a maximum of 15 years
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued the Notice on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. The notice states that commercial properties purchased with loans must be completed and filed for record. Banking financial institutions issuing loans for commercial property purchases should comply with minimum down payment ratio requirements. The loan term for commercial property purchases generally should not exceed 10 years, with a maximum of 15 years. For individuals applying for commercial property purchase loans, the upper limits for housing loan payment-to-income ratio and total debt payment-to-income ratio should follow the same standards as personal housing loans.

headlines.title: 两部门：预售项目贷款期限原则上不超过3年，最长不超过5年
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》的通知：房地产开发贷款期限应与项目建设、销售周期相匹配，覆盖项目开工到竣工备案全过程。预售项目贷款期限原则上不超过3年，最长不超过5年；现房销售项目贷款期限原则上不超过5年，最长不超过7年。贷款用于商业地产开发的，期限原则上不超过7年。首次还本日期原则上应在项目竣工备案后，经协商一致的可以提前归还贷款本金。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Pre-sale project loan terms should generally not exceed 3 years, with a maximum of 5 years
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued the Notice on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. The loan term for real estate development loans should match the project construction and sales cycle, covering the entire process from project start to completion filing. For presale projects, the loan term should generally not exceed 3 years, with a maximum of 5 years; for completed property sales projects, the loan term should generally not exceed 5 years, with a maximum of 7 years. For loans used in commercial real estate development, the term should generally not exceed 7 years. The first principal repayment date should generally be after the project's completion filing, but early principal repayment can be made upon mutual agreement.

headlines.title: 证监会：严防严打房地产证券发行人欺诈发行、信息披露造假、挪用募集资金等违法违规行为
headlines.summary: 证监会发布关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见。坚决打击和遏制违法违规行为。落实中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅《关于依法从严打击证券违法活动的意见》，严防严打房地产证券发行人欺诈发行、信息披露造假、挪用募集资金等违法违规行为，加大对系统性、团伙性造假的惩戒力度，强化对第三方配合造假以及保荐人、承销机构、会计师事务所等中介机构证券违法违规行为的打击力度，对各类财务造假行为“零容忍”。对于情节恶劣、市场影响重大、引致重大风险的违法案件，依法从严处罚。

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Strictly prevent and crack down on fraudulent issuance, information disclosure造假, and misappropriation of raised funds by real estate securities issuers and other violations
headlines.summary_en: The CSRC issued opinions on supporting the establishment of a new model for real estate development through the capital market. It will resolutely crack down on and curb illegal and non-compliant activities. In implementing the Opinions on Strictly Cracking Down on Securities Illegal Activities in accordance with the Law issued by the General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, it will strictly prevent and crack down on fraudulent issuance, information disclosure fraud, and misappropriation of raised funds by real estate securities issuers, intensify penalties for systematic and gang-style fraud, strengthen efforts to combat third-party complicity in fraud and securities violations by sponsor institutions, underwriting institutions, accounting firms, and other intermediaries, and maintain zero tolerance for all forms of financial fraud. For illegal cases with egregious circumstances, significant market impact, or major risks, penalties will be imposed strictly in accordance with the law.

headlines.summary: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》的通知。通知提出，银行业金融机构发放个人住房贷款应符合最低首付比例要求。个人住房贷款期限最长不超过40年，金额不得超过拟购买住房的评估价值。贷款期限在1年以内（含1年）的，实行到期一次性还本付息或按月还本付息；贷款期限在1年以上的，按月还本付息。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Personal housing loan terms should not exceed 40 years, and the amount must not exceed the appraised value of the housing to be purchased
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued the Notice on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. The notice states that banking financial institutions issuing personal housing loans should comply with minimum down payment ratio requirements. The maximum term for personal housing loans should not exceed 40 years, and the loan amount should not exceed the appraised value of the housing to be purchased. For loan terms of 1 year or less (including 1 year), repayment is made in a lump sum of principal and interest at maturity or monthly principal and interest payments; for loan terms exceeding 1 year, repayment is made monthly.

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Extend personal housing loan terms from a maximum of 30 years to a maximum of 40 years
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued the Notice on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. The notice states that the maximum term for personal housing loans should not exceed 40 years, and the loan amount should not exceed the appraised value of the housing to be purchased. For loan terms of 1 year or less (including 1 year), repayment is made in a lump sum of principal and interest at maturity or monthly principal and interest payments; for loan terms exceeding 1 year, repayment is made monthly.

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Banking financial institutions should strengthen closed management of real estate development loans to ensure dedicated use of funds
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued the Notice on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. The notice states that banking financial institutions should not issue loans for paying land transfer fees and related taxes. Banking financial institutions can issue real estate development loans during the development and construction stage, including commercial housing development loans, affordable housing development loans, rental housing development and construction loans, and commercial real estate development loans. Banking financial institutions should strengthen closed management of real estate development loans, ensure earmarked use, and align loan disbursement with the project construction cycle. Banking financial institutions can issue home purchase loans during the real estate sales stage, including personal housing loans, rental housing group purchase loans, and commercial property purchase loans. Banking financial institutions should strictly implement the issuance of personal housing loans.

headlines.summary: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局28日联合印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理 推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，为适应经济社会发展需要，《意见》将个人住房贷款期限由最长30年延长至最长40年，给予借贷双方更大灵活度，具体期限由购房人与商业银行协商确定。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: The 'Opinions' extend personal housing loan terms from a maximum of 30 years to a maximum of 40 years, providing greater flexibility for both lenders and borrowers
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development on the 28th. To adapt to the needs of economic and social development, the Opinions extends the maximum term for personal housing loans from 30 years to 40 years, giving both lenders and borrowers greater flexibility, with the specific term determined through consultation between the homebuyer and the commercial bank.

headlines.title: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局印发《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》的通知

headlines.title_en: PBOC and National Financial Regulatory Administration issue notice on 'Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Construction of a New Model of Real Estate Development'
headlines.summary_en: The loan term for real estate development loans should match the project construction and sales cycle, covering the entire process from project start to completion filing. For presale projects, the loan term should generally not exceed 3 years, with a maximum of 5 years; for completed property sales projects, the loan term should generally not exceed 5 years, with a maximum of 7 years. For loans used in commercial real estate development, the term should generally not exceed 7 years. The first principal repayment date should generally be after the project's completion filing, but early principal repayment can be made upon mutual agreement.

headlines.title: 证监会：支持上市房地产开发企业并购重组
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月28日讯，证监会发布关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见。支持上市房地产开发企业并购重组。发挥资本市场在企业并购重组中的主渠道作用，支持上市房地产开发企业综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产，其中发行股份、定向可转债购买资产的，可以募集配套资金，并用于符合政策要求的房地产项目和支付本次重组交易对价等。建筑等与房地产密切相关行业的上市公司，参照上市房地产开发企业政策执行。

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Support mergers and acquisitions and restructuring of listed real estate development enterprises
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — The CSRC issued opinions on supporting the establishment of a new model for real estate development through the capital market. It supports mergers and acquisitions and restructuring of listed real estate development companies. The capital market's main channel role in corporate M&A and restructuring will be leveraged, supporting listed real estate development companies to comprehensively use tools such as shares, targeted convertible bonds, and cash to acquire real estate-related assets. When issuing shares or targeted convertible bonds to purchase assets, matching fundraising can be conducted, with proceeds used for real estate projects meeting policy requirements and paying transaction consideration for the restructuring. Listed companies in industries closely related to real estate, such as construction, will follow the same policies as listed real estate development companies.

headlines.title: 证监会：严把房地产开发企业证券发行入口关，突出“基于项目”融资特点

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Strictly control the entry of real estate development enterprises for securities issuance, highlighting 'project-based' financing characteristics

headlines.title: 两部门：建立开发贷款主办银行制度
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月28日讯，中国人民银行有关部门负责人就《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》答记者问。建立开发贷款主办银行制度，提升房地产行业转型发展的金融服务能力。《意见》明确，单个房地产项目对应一家主办银行，单独或牵头银团发放开发贷款。开发贷款期限应与项目建设、销售周期相匹配，覆盖项目开工到竣工备案全过程，预售项目最长5年，现房销售项目最长7年，商业地产项目最长7年，首次还本日期原则上应在项目竣工备案后。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: Establish a lead bank system for development loans
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — A relevant official from the People's Bank of China answered reporter questions on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. Establish a lead bank system for development loans to enhance financial service capabilities for the transformation and development of the real estate industry. The Opinions clarifies that a single real estate project corresponds to one lead bank, which issues development loans individually or as the lead bank of a syndicate. The development loan term should match the project construction and sales cycle, covering the entire process from project start to completion filing, with a maximum of 5 years for presale projects, a maximum of 7 years for completed property sales projects, and a maximum of 7 years for commercial real estate projects. The first principal repayment date should generally be after the project's completion filing.

headlines.summary: 证监会发布关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见。坚决打击和遏制违法违规行为。落实中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅《关于依法从严打击证券违法活动的意见》，严防严打房地产证券发行人欺诈发行、信息披露造假、挪用募集资金等违法违规行为，加大对系统性、团伙性造假的惩戒力度，强化对第三方配合造假以及保荐人、承销机构、会计师事务所等中介机构证券违法违规行为的打击力度，对各类财务造假行为“零容忍”。对于情节恶劣、市场影响重大、引致重大风险的违法案件，依法从严处罚。

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Support refinancing by listed real estate development enterprises
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — The CSRC issued opinions on supporting the establishment of a new model for real estate development through the capital market. Support refinancing by listed real estate development companies. Strengthen the role of the capital market, supporting listed real estate development companies to conduct refinancing through issuance to specific targets, with raised funds directed to market-oriented real estate projects meeting policy requirements, and the project development companies responsible for implementation should meet regulatory requirements. For refinancing by overseas-listed real estate development companies, continue to complete relevant filing procedures in accordance with relevant regulations.

headlines.title: 央行、金融监管总局：改革完善房地产信贷管理 推动加快构建房地产发展新模式
headlines.summary: 【央行、金融监管总局：改革完善房地产信贷管理 推动加快构建房地产发展新模式】为完善房地产信贷管理，维护购房人合法权益，满足行业合理融资需求，促进房地产市场稳健运行，加快构建房地产发展新模式，推动房地产高质量发展，根据《中华人民共和国中国人民银行法》《中华人民共和国银行业监督管理法》《中华人民共和国商业银行法》等法律法规，制定本意见。

headlines.title_en: PBOC and Financial Regulatory Administration: Reform and Improve Real Estate Credit Management, Accelerate Construction of New Real Estate Development Model
headlines.summary_en: 【PBOC, Financial Regulators: Reform and Improve Real Estate Credit Management, Promote Faster Establishment of New Real Estate Development Model】To improve real estate credit management, protect homebuyers' lawful rights, meet reasonable industry financing needs, promote stable real estate market operation, accelerate building a new real estate development model, and drive high-quality real estate development, these opinions are formulated under the Law of the People's Republic of China on the People's Bank of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on Banking Regulation and Supervision, and the Law of the People's Republic of China on Commercial Banks.

headlines.title: 财政部等三部门：规范转让上市公司限售股个人所得税政策
headlines.summary: 一、个人转让上市公司限售股取得的所得，按照“财产转让所得”，适用20%税率缴纳个人所得税。本公告所称限售股包括《财政部 国家税务总局 证监会关于个人转让上市公司限售股所得征收个人所得税有关问题的通知》（财税〔2009〕167号）第二条规定的限售股，以及其在解禁日后孳生且在本公告实施后办理股权登记的送、转股。 限售股发生送、转、缩股的，证券登记结算公司应当依据送、转、缩股比例对限售股成本原值进行调整。

headlines.title_en: Finance Ministry and Two Other Departments: Regulate Individual Income Tax Policy on Transfer of Restricted Shares in Listed Companies
headlines.summary_en: 1. Income derived by individuals from transferring restricted shares of listed companies shall be subject to individual income tax at a rate of 20% under the category of income from transfer of property. Restricted shares as referred to in this announcement include restricted shares specified in Article 2 of the Notice on Issues Concerning the Collection of Individual Income Tax on Income from Transfer of Restricted Shares of Listed Companies by Individuals (Cai Shui [2009] No. 167) of the Ministry of Finance, the State Administration of Taxation, and the CSRC, as well as bonus shares and converted shares arising therefrom after the lifting of the lock-up period and registered as equity after the implementation of this announcement. When restricted shares undergo bonus share issuance, conversion, or share consolidation, the securities registration and settlement company should adjust the original cost of restricted shares based on the ratios of bonus shares, conversion, or consolidation.

headlines.title_en: Three Departments: Support Real Estate Project Development Companies in Financing via Equity, Bonds and Other Methods
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued a notice on improving the commercial housing sales system. The notice mentioned strengthening financing support. Real estate projects will adopt a lead bank system, where the project development company and the lead bank mutually select each other, one project designates one lead bank, and the lead bank alone or by forming a syndicated loan team provides development loans and other financing services.

headlines.title: 三部门：有力有序推行商品住房现房销售
headlines.summary: 住房城乡建设部、自然资源部、金融监管总局发布关于完善商品住房销售制度的通知。通知提到，各地要有力有序推行商品住房现房销售，实现“所见即所得”，减少商品住房交付纠纷，从根本上防范交付风险，维护购房人合法权益，加快构建房地产发展新模式。

headlines.title_en: Three Departments: Vigorously and Orderly Promote Spot Sales of Commercial Housing
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued a notice on improving the commercial housing sales system. The notice mentioned that localities should vigorously and orderly promote spot sales of commercial housing, achieving 'what you see is what you get,' reducing delivery disputes, fundamentally preventing delivery risks, protecting homebuyers' lawful rights, and accelerating the establishment of a new real estate development model.

headlines.title: 长鑫科技：展望2026年下半年，全球 DRAM 产品供给紧缺格局将继续延续
headlines.summary: 长鑫科技表示，展望2026年下半年，全球 DRAM 产品供给紧缺格局将继续延续。公司将持续关注宏观经济波动、地缘政治局势等外部影响，直面多重挑战，把握发展机遇，锚定全年业绩增长目标、新应用场景拓展、重点项目落地、产学研深度融合等方向发力，力争在运营效能提升、产品迭代升级、长期发展布局、开放协同创新等方面取得更大突破，进一步强化核心竞争力，扩大市场影响力。

headlines.title_en: CXMT: Expects Global DRAM Product Supply Shortage to Continue into Second Half of 2026
headlines.summary_en: ChangXin Memory Technologies stated that looking ahead to the second half of 2026, the global DRAM product supply shortage will continue. The company will keep monitoring external impacts such as macroeconomic fluctuations and geopolitical situations, face multiple challenges head-on, seize development opportunities, and focus on full-year performance growth targets, expansion of new application scenarios, implementation of key projects, and deep industry-academia-research integration, striving for greater breakthroughs in operational efficiency improvement, product iteration and upgrades, long-term development planning, and open collaborative innovation, further strengthening core competitiveness and expanding market influence.
